clips.title: The story
paras: Felpaw Village is a corrupted furbolg settlement nestled in the far northern reaches of Felwood, guarding the mountain path leading directly to Timbermaw Hold. Inhabited by the fallen Deadwood tribe, its huts and gathering grounds are tainted by demonic influence and hostile to all outsiders.

Situated at the northern edge of Felwood, Felpaw Village serves as the primary northern redoubt for the fallen Deadwood furbolgs. Once gentle forest wardens, the tribe fell victim to the demonic blight unleashed during the Third War, driving them into a state of feral madness. Now, the village stands as a blighted enclave filled with crude huts, ritual totems, and hostile warriors who attack anyone wandering near the tunnel entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

The proximity of Felpaw Village to the sacred entrance of Timbermaw Hold makes it a critical threat to the few uncorrupted furbolgs remaining in the region. The Timbermaw guards posted at the northern mouth of Felwood view their fallen cousins with a mixture of mourning and vigilance, frequently calling upon travelers to cull the Deadwood ranks, seize their ritual fetishes, and keep the corruption from spilling through the gates into Moonglade and Winterspring.
